mapper.insert: insert into corgi_user_goods(user_id, goods_id, goods_type, price, currency, trader_id, trade_no, `desc`, merch_id, market_id) values (#{goods.userId}, #{goods.goodsId}, #{goods.goodsType}, #{goods.price}, #{goods.currency}, #{goods.traderId}, #{goods.tradeNo}, #{goods.desc}, #{goods.merchId}, #{goods.marketId})
mapper.select: select count(1) from corgi_user_goods where trade_no = #{tradeNo} and status = 1

select `user_id` userId, `goods_type` goodsType, `merch_id` merchId, `goods_id` goodsId, sum(price) price, currency, `status` from corgi_user_goods where goods_type = #{goods.goodsType} and status = '1' group by goods_id order by price desc desc limit #{goods.start}, #{goods.size}
